purpose: Second round on the same 300-name 2018-2025 earnings_vol cache: weekly calendars and diagonals held through earnings at several strike distances (user idea: short the first post-earnings weekly, long the following weekly, at strikes just outside the expected move from the ATM straddle or a single ATM put), plus reverse calendars, post-event theta and direction trades and history-driven directional verticals.
prior_exposure: research5 and research4 evaluated other strategies on every year and name here; research5 included ATM calendars with a monthly-style back expiry. No sample is a pristine holdout; the four-way split is kept identical to research5 so that results are comparable, and the stage-D test is out-of-selection for this protocol only.
reuse: Event alignment, information set, stock/quote caches, liquidity tiers, dividend exclusion, fees, cost sensitivities, inference and samples are exactly as research5/protocol.json (sha256 ee89673b6c02f7a55aea45fb632e14e37cb10ea49fa54abcb1a1984d28331b8b), except where stated here.

expiries.front: First expiry quoted at entry with exdate >= the E+1 session date and exdate <= E + 10 calendar days (the first post-earnings expiry, normally a weekly)
expiries.back_1w: Next quoted expiry whose exdate is 6-8 calendar days after the front
expiries.back_2w: Quoted expiry 13-15 calendar days after the front
expiries.post_event: Post-event trades use the first expiry with exdate >= exit session date + 1 day and <= exit + 21 days

distances.M: ATM straddle mid / stock close at entry for the front expiry (ATM = strike nearest the close with both sides quoted)
distances.put: d = ATM put mid / stock close (the single-ATM-put expected move, roughly M/2)
distances.edge_strikes: Call strike = lowest quoted front strike >= S(1+d); put strike = highest quoted front strike <= S(1-d); both must also be quoted in the back expiry

families.atm_call_calendar: Sell front ATM call, buy back_1w call at the same strike
families.atm_put_calendar: Sell front ATM put, buy back_1w put at the same strike
families.atm_straddle_calendar: Sell front ATM straddle, buy back_1w straddle at the same strike
families.double_calendar_put: Sell front OTM call and put at the 'put' edges; buy the same strikes in back_1w
families.double_calendar_straddle_2w: Same at 1.0 M edges with back_2w instead of back_1w
families.double_diagonal_put: Sell front at the 'put' edges; buy back_1w one quoted strike further out on each side
families.double_diagonal_straddle: Sell front at 1.0 M edges; buy back_1w one quoted strike further out on each side
families.reverse_straddle_calendar: Buy front ATM straddle, sell back_1w straddle at the same strike
families.post_iron_fly: At E+1 close: sell ATM straddle, buy wings nearest +/- 1.0 x straddle (post-event expiry)
families.post_momentum_vertical: At E+1 close: buy a debit vertical in the direction of J_E = log(close E+1 / close E-1): long ATM, short nearest strike beyond S(1 +/- M_post) (call side if J_E > 0, put side if J_E < 0)
families.post_reversal_vertical: Same vertical in the opposite direction of J_E
families.hist_drift_vertical: At entry: debit vertical (long ATM, short nearest beyond S(1 +/- M)) in the direction of the mean J over the name's last 8 earlier events; skipped if that mean is exactly zero or unavailable

timings.hold_front: Exit at the last session on or before min(front exdate, E+3 session date). If that session is the front expiration date, front legs are settled at intrinsic value from the stock close; back legs at their closing midpoint. If the front expires after E+3 the trade exits at E+3 midpoints.
timings.after_release: As research5 (E or E+1 by the name's earlier release pattern)
timings.front_on_exit_day: Whenever the exit session is the front expiration date, front legs settle at intrinsic value from the stock close

risk_normalization: Same-strike calendars: debit. Diagonals: debit + largest strike gap between short and long legs on a side. Reverse calendar: back-leg entry mid value (credit packages lose at most roughly the back legs' value). Debit verticals: debit. post_iron_fly: max wing width - credit. Risk below $20 per unit, non-positive debit (calendars, diagonals, verticals) or non-positive credit (reverse calendar, iron fly) skips the package.

signals.R: research5 R with the background horizon to the front expiry
signals.TSw: Front ATM implied vol / back_1w ATM implied vol, Black-Scholes r=0, time in weekdays/252
signals.D: Implied ex-event diffusion vol / historical background vol: sigma_d^2 = (IV_b^2 T_b - IV_f^2 T_f)/(T_b - T_f) from ATM front and back_1w IVs (weekdays/252); D = sigma_d / (research5 EWMA background daily vol x sqrt(252)); missing if sigma_d^2 <= 0
signals.JM: Post-event only: |J_E| / M_pre, M_pre = research5 implied move at E-1 for the standard front
signals.DRIFT: |mean J over last 8 earlier events| / H, directional family only

candidate_grid: Every family x its timings x its filters x {standard, tight} liquidity; generated by research6.candidates and hashed in the frozen file.
selection: Identical to research5: eligibility (>=150 issuer-events, >=40 issuers, <=1% unresolved, mean > 0 at 25% half-spread cost, mean > 0 excluding best 5); objective = cluster-robust lower 95% bound of mean midpoint return on sample A; freeze up to 5 policies, at most one per family; B, C, D are gates only.
walk_forward: Identical to research5, over this protocol's grid.
limitations_added: Settlement at intrinsic from the closing stock price ignores pin risk, after-hours moves on expiration day and early assignment
Back-week quotes are needed at exit; trades whose back legs lack exit quotes are unresolved
Reverse-calendar risk is an approximation, not a broker margin requirement
